text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower hasn't shown up for training...
Just as that thought crosses my mind—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Actually, I found a bud in the flower bed that looks like it's about to bloom...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"I was cheering you on while watching, and before I knew it, it got this late...
I'm so sorry..."
Nishino Flower seemed genuinely remorseful, so I told her to be more careful next time and let the matter rest.
